system:hero.subtext: Ten goals, narrowed to three. Repeatable daily and weekly actions. Three systems — written, visual, mental — that keep you showing up.
system:hero.title: Dreams become measurable.

system:mentalEntries.body: Someone who shows up on the boring days, not just the motivated ones.

system:mentalEntries.body: One missed day is an accident. Two in a row is the start of a new habit — don't let it become that.
system:mentalEntries.title: When I miss a day

system:mentalEntries.body: If the smallest version of the habit still feels like too much, it's not small enough yet — shrink it further.
system:mentalEntries.title: Make the MVA impossible to skip

system:processes.description:
Sunday evening, 30 minutes:
1. Clear the inbox to zero.
2. Review last week's system-action checks.
3. Pick this week's one priority.
4. Plan tomorrow's first hour.
system:processes.title: Weekly Reset
